support_spans: biopsy specimens were negative for carcinoma but demonstrated amyloid protein deposition
candidates.why: The presence of amyloid protein deposition in the biopsy specimens supports this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Urethral Stricture
support_spans: Retrograde urethrography showed an approximately 2-cm segment of stenosis in the penile urethra
candidates.why: The finding of a 2-cm segment of stenosis in the penile urethra is consistent with a urethral stricture.

candidates.name: Urothelial Carcinoma

contradict_spans: biopsy specimens were negative for carcinoma
